name: Aether
description: Aether is the energy that flows through Kaladesh, which is refined and distributed as a power source.

summary.text: Aether is the energy that flows through Kaladesh, which is refined and distributed as a power source.

bio.text: Nissa found that the way aether flows through the city could guide her group to the Dhund, perceiving the plane's aether as a vast river network.
Avaati Vya cracked the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates its energy-rich part from its volatile part.
The Consulate then developed mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.

status.text: The latest event shows the Consulate mass-producing and distributing refined aether across Kaladesh.

timeline.summary: Nissa works out that the way aether flows through the city can guide them to the Dhund.
timeline.quote: It has to do with the way aether flows through the city.

timeline.summary: Concentrating, Nissa perceives the plane's aether as a vast river network and tracks a trickle from underground tunnels.
timeline.quote: The world suddenly sprawled vast across her awareness, like a map unrolled and spread upon a table.

timeline.summary: Avaati Vya cracks the aether code, developing a refinement process that separates aether's energy-rich part from its volatile part.
timeline.quote: Six decades ago, the world-renowned aetherologist Avaati Vya cracked the aether code.

timeline.summary: The Consulate develops mass production and distribution of refined aether, with airships and pipelines.
timeline.quote: The Consulate developed methods for mass production and distribution of refined aether.

pages_say.description: Energy in the air of Kaladesh that the Consulate siphons and stores in devices.
The energy of Kaladesh, observed in flowing patterns.
Raw potential energy filling Kaladesh's air and powering its airships and pipes.
The energy flowing through Kaladesh that Nissa can track.
A mystical blue substance present throughout the Multiverse that on Kaladesh can be seen, touched and devoured, and is refined into an energy source.
The magical energy that inhabits the space between planes, concentrated and abundant on Kaladesh as a life-giving resource.
The substance aetherborn are made of, restricted by the Consulate's ordinances.
The blue energy that powers the transporter and the Inquirium.
Kaladesh's blue energy, whose allocation has become political.
Blue energy Kari steals and uses as bait.
The energy that makes aetherborn and connects planes.
A raw magical energy critical to Avishkar's ecosystem and culture of invention.
